description: Lossless historical archive of v1.0.0 placeholder animations, character reference sheet, v1 brand static copies, v1 QC sprite sheet, and superseded v1 generation scripts.

subdirectories.animations: Complete v1.0.0 6-state (34-frame) placeholder animation pack + manifest.json recovered from v0.1.0 (Git HEAD).
subdirectories.characters: Reserved directory (no standalone single-character portraits existed in v1 separate from references/piku-character-sheet.png and animations/).
subdirectories.static: Verified copies of v1 brand logo/icon assets (originals kept in assets/logo/ for README).
subdirectories.references: Verified copy of original v1 character sheet (original kept in assets/piku-character-sheet.png).
subdirectories.other: Superseded v1 asset generator and raw-strip slicer scripts moved out of scripts/assets/.
